entry.title: Oregon Expands Building Code Options To Allow More Four-Unit Housing Developments
entry.summary: Oregon has approved a new building code option allowing qualifying residential buildings to contain up to four dwelling units, providing greater design flexibility for smaller multifamily housing projects statewide.

entry.summary: Oregon residents and visitors can enjoy free fishing, crabbing and clamming November 27-28. No licenses or tags are required, but all other fishing regulations remain in effect.

entry.summary: Douglas County is launching a free mattress recycling program November 25 at the Roseburg Transfer Station. Residents can drop off up to three eligible mattresses per day at no cost, provided they meet recycling requirements.

entry.title: Roseburg City Offices to Close Nov. 26-27 for Thanksgiving Holiday

entry.title: Oregon’s Unemployment Rate Holds Steady at 4.9% as Construction and Retail Jobs Decline
entry.summary: Oregon’s unemployment rate dipped to 4.9% in October as the state lost 300 jobs. Health care and professional services added positions, while construction and retail saw declines. Douglas County employment figures are expected November 24.
